states.name: first-attempt
states.description: USSR to act at the start of the track with a 3-op and a 1-op card. Box 1 needs 2+ ops and a roll of 1-3.

states.name: second-in
states.description: USSR to act, the US already in box 1: reaching it second pays 1 VP instead of 2.

states.name: animal-in-space-leader
states.description: US leads into Animal in Space (box 2) and has made one attempt this turn: its perk allows a second.

states.name: animal-in-space-cancelled
states.description: Both sides have reached box 2, so its perk is gone: the US has used its one attempt this turn.

states.name: space-station-ussr
states.description: USSR holds the Space Station box (8 action rounds); the US is about to finish AR 6 of 6, so the USSR plays ARs 7 and 8 alone.

states.name: space-station-cancelled
states.description: Both sides have reached the Space Station, so nobody gets eighth action rounds.

states.name: nazi-scientist
states.description: US to act with Captured Nazi Scientist: moves the US marker from 0 to box 1 (2 VP for being first).

states.name: one-small-step-behind
states.description: USSR to act with One Small Step, 2 boxes behind: moves from 0 to box 2, VP only from the last box (second into Animal in Space: 0).

states.name: one-small-step-not-behind
states.description: Level on the track, so One Small Step does nothing.

states.name: vp-win-by-space
states.description: US at 18 VP and in box 6: reaching the Space Shuttle first pays 4 VP and wins the game.

states.name: china-card
states.description: USSR holds the China Card face up (4 ops) — but it can't be used for the space race.
